experiences.title: Machine Learning Engineer
experiences.company: Genpact India Pvt Ltd. · Bangalore, India
experiences.description: Led proofs of concept and built ML predictive models through to deployment. Handled data preparation, feature engineering, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning and AWS Glue, cutting an algorithm's run time from 3 minutes to 1. Optimized GPU utilization for CatBoost and XGBoost training by 22%, and raised a Random Forest classifier's accuracy on a large real-time racing dataset from 78% to 86% with Bayesian Optimization. Ran code reviews and end-to-end testing, and automated model deployment on virtual machine servers.
